newsitem.title: CANADA: Romarco Minerals buys Nevada gold property.
newsitem.headline: Romarco Minerals buys Nevada gold property.

text.p: Romarco Minerals Inc said it had bought 60 percent interest in Barrick Gold Corp's Rand property in Nevada.
Romarco said in a release issued late Tuesday it has agreed to spend US$500,000 to explore the property over a three year property.
The agreement is with Lac Minerals Inc, which is 100 percent owned by Barrick.
The property, in the Rand Bovard mining district, consists of 222 claims or 4,000 acres and is a volcanic hosted epithermal gold property, Romarco said.
The company said it wants to complete 10,000 feet of reverse circulation drilling to test seven separate gold targets on the property during 1996.
Romarco also plans to drill on seven of its other properties this year and said it will continue to seek more land in Nevada.
